read_scope: 26 source records actually read in named sections. F4-S020 is publisher abstract only; F4-S018/019/022/024 are selected public PDF text read using Python/PyMuPDF; F4-S023 is selected public PMC HTML body. No assertion of full papers or source-by-source independent verification.
dedup_scope: Before authoring, searched current 2661 raw questions/targets and manually read 286 keyword-filtered rows plus targeted L/P/D/H/V and legacy food cores. Re-read named nearest old IDs and early 16-question semantic neighbors. This is not an exhaustive human review of all 2661 rows; final semantic rerun and independent author review remain.
source_cautions: F4-S011 is retained as evidence for rejected F4014; it no longer supports a counted candidate.
Exploratorium糖段只作教育簡化模型；正確定位已修。過度連結失水在Why add vinegar?首段，不採其後酸中和蛋白解釋。
Exploratorium meat text contains simplifications; collagen conversion is not claimed to mean raw collagen directly dissolves in cold water.
UF persimmon PDF includes unrelated health/operation and p6 chemistry claims that are not adopted. Only tannin binding and acetaldehyde insolubilization are used.
Rice mechanism is backed by the study washing/composition comparison; no numerical result or source figure is copied.
Umami receptor binding is stated as a model supported by mutagenesis, not direct molecular filming.
Espresso uneven flow is a model interpretation of extraction measurements; no claim of measured channel geometry or a universal grind recipe.
Meat color is not an eating-safety or doneness test. Chemical oxygenation and oxidation are distinguished.

questions_for_reviewer.issue: Raw granule gelatinization vs pregelatinized process history: author sees different observable condition but accepts same-core merge if only retelling.
Only retain if distinct acid ingredients and reaction-stage timing add a real mechanism. General acid/carbonate gas is already old.
Many small nuclei vs few large crystals changes size distribution; check whether sufficient increment beyond delayed nucleation.
Air/water protein unfolding and linking vs oil/water new-surface adsorption; both are interface stabilization, check core overlap.
Sugar slowing formation vs retaining water needs a more precise mechanism source before scripting; short segment only.
Overaggregation/syneresis in egg foam vs acid-driven pectin contraction may be same underlying failure core. Do not retain solely for egg material.
Source explicitly supports pigment conversion but does not explain magnesium substitution. If too thin without that step, hold rather than fill with generic chemistry.
Layer-separated steam vs timing/setting and shortening: distinguish architecture from mere fat and gas example.
Overlap window of substrate accessibility and enzyme survival versus already-collected individual mechanisms; abstract-only evidence limits detail.
Cold-induced sucrose/invertase pathway vs ripening starch-to-sugar; if trigger difference is insufficient, merge and retain potato example.

rejected_after_reading.reason: Different available acid quantity is a condition of same gas reaction.
Endogenous instead of exogenous protease does not by itself make a new protein-cleavage core.
